title: Enumerate and Align
description: Add a rank field to each object starting from 1 and align the fields neatly.
tips:
1. Select the list (e.g. 'vip').
2. s searches inside selection. Input \{<enter>
3. a to insert ' rank: ' after {
4. <ctrl-r># inserts numbers
5. Align with s "<enter>& (aligns on starting quotes)
